description: Shared verdict fixture for the Activity decode-overhead gate (#1925). activity-stream.spec.mjs and scripts/webui/activity_performance_verdict_tests.py both evaluate every case and must reproduce `expected` exactly. Recorded cases copy activity-performance.log samples from the webui-activity-performance-diagnostics-Linux artifacts named in `source` (copied here because artifacts expire); `look` evaluates the recorded pairs at their own count, `sequence` replays every look and requires the run to have stopped at its first decision, `pairs` checks pairing only.
